items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Walter Williams, Gerald Wilson and myself. That was the trumpet section we took into Benny Carter’s band.

ctx.x: And that’s when Gerald said, it was Fred Traynor, Williams.

Walter Williams, Gerald Wilson and myself. That was the trumpet section we took into Benny Carter’s band. And also if you’d like to hear that trumpet section on film, you can hear us in “This is the Army” with a 60-piece Warner Brothers orchestra, with four trumpets and we are those four trumpets. Yes.
